facts.lap-pentacle: The queen holds a large pentacle in both hands on her lap and looks down at it.
facts.rose-canopy: A vine with red roses in bloom hangs over her head.
facts.carved-throne: Horned goat heads are on the arms of the throne, and baby faces and fruit are also carved on it.
facts.rabbit: In the grass at the lower right is a rabbit.
facts.landscape: Mountains, a river and fields spread out behind, and the sky is yellow.
facts.robes: She wears a red garment with a green cloak and a crown.

glosses.rabbit: Abundance and vitality close to everyday life.
glosses.rose-canopy: Plenty, surrounded by a garden you have tended.

reversedGloss.waning: The strength to care drops, and she has no room to look after herself.
reversedGloss.excess: Material caretaking goes too far and becomes interference.

misdescriptions.wrong: There are lion heads on the throne.
She holds the pentacle high up.
